title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Kit & Nordic Spirit Bundle
description: The Avomi Cliq Bundle offers a versatile and high-performance nicotine solution, pairing two advanced vape kits with a pack of premium nicotine pouches. This exclusive set includes two complete Avomi Cliq Kits—delivering a massive combined potential of up to 12,000 puffs—plus one pack of Nordic Spirit Nicotine Pouches. This combination is designed for the modern vaper who requires a reliable, high-capacity device for general use, alongside a discreet, smoke-free alternative for environments where vaping is not permitted. The Avomi Cliq features a substantial 12ml hybrid e-liquid system (2ml pod + 10ml auto-refill container) and a powerful 950mAh rechargeable battery. With its Turbo and Normal power modes, you can customise your vape for intensity or longevity, while the LED digital display keeps you informed of your battery status. Nordic Spirit Nicotine Pouches provide a tobacco-free way to absorb nicotine without smoke or vapour. These soft, white pouches fit discreetly under the lip, releasing flavour and nicotine for up to 60 minutes. Available in various strengths (Regular, Strong, X-Strong), they are the ideal travel companion for office days or long journeys. Available Bundle Flavours: Avomi Kit Flavours: Includes high-performance options like Blueberry Ice, Cola Ice, Lemon & Lime, and Raspberry Blackcurrant. Nordic Spirit Flavours: Available in refreshing profiles such as Mint, Spearmint, and Watermelon, in varied nicotine strengths to suit your preference. How To Set Up Your Avomi CLIQ Device Step 1 Insert the 10ml refill container and the 2ml pod into the device. Step 2 Allow the system to prime for a moment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Step 4 Use the switch (if applicable) or draw style to toggle Turbo/Normal modes. ✅ Ready to vape How To Use Nordic Spirit Nicotine Pouches Step 1 Place one pouch under your upper or lower lip. Step 2 You may feel a tingling sensation as the nicotine releases. Step 3 Keep in place for up to 60 minutes, then dispose of responsibly using the waste compartment in the lid. ✅ Discreet & smoke-free Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
